Author: CandyApple
Name: ReshadeController
Punchline: Controls ReShade shaders based on what's going on in game
Description: Dynamic ReShade presets that react to what's happening in game — time of day, weather, location and more — through a visual node Animator, plus per-zone, cutscene and duty presets. Requires ReShade with the reshade_controller addon in the game folder.
